name: 円香
text: ──録画開始
trans: ──And action.

name: 小糸
text:
ぴぇ……！？
え、えっと……
trans:
Pyeh...!?
E-Erm.....

name: 小糸
text: こ、こんにちはー……！
trans: H-Hi thereー...!

name: 透
text: テストでーす
trans: Test teest.

name: 雛菜
text:
あは～
映ってる～？
trans:
Aha～
Can you see me～?

name: 円香
text: 問題ない
trans: All green.

name: 透
text: え、それで──
trans: Eh, is that for──

name: 円香
text: Vlog？
trans: Vlog-ing?

name: 透
text:
うん
何するやつ？　それ
trans:
Yea.
Of us doing things? That.

name: 雛菜
text:
すき～とか、楽しい～ってことを撮るのが多いかも
毎日撮ってる人もいるよね～
trans:
Many vlogs are like, about things people like～, or
things that are fun～ And there are those who
make vlogs everyday too～

name: 円香
text:
……まあ、そういうのがあればいいけど
ブログの動画版みたいなものって考えればいいみたいだから
trans:
...Well, we'll be fine if that's all it takes. We can
just think of it as a video version of writing a blog.

name: 円香
text:
ようするに、オフっぽい感じで撮ればいいんでしょ？
知らないけど
trans:
In other words, we just need to shoot ourselves
chilling, right? Don't know if that'll work, though.

name: 透
text: じゃ、オフでーす
trans: Here, I'm chilliiing out.

name: 小糸
text: で、でーす……！
trans: M-Me, too...!

name: 雛菜
text: 雛菜、今ほうじ茶ラテ飲んでる～！
trans: Hinana's having some houjicha latte～!

name: 円香
text: 最近それじゃない？
trans: Haven't you been into that lately?

name: 雛菜
text:
うん～
これ期間限定だから、終わっちゃう前にいっぱい飲むんだ～
trans:
Yea～　It's a limited time drink, so I've been drinking a
ton of these before the promotion ends～

name: 円香
text: へえ
trans: Heh.

name: 小糸
text: みんな、今日課題もやるんだよね……？
trans:
So, like always, everyone's gathered to do  homework,
right...?

name: 透
text: あー、そうだっけ
trans: Ahh, was that the plan?

name: 円香
text: ……まあ、言ってたけど
trans: ...Well, we did discuss about it.

name: 円香
text: 小糸はとっくに終わらせてるでしょ？
trans: But you've already finished yours, right, Koito?

name: 小糸
text: う、うん！
trans: Y-Yea!

name: 雛菜
text: 小糸ちゃんえらい～
trans: Koito-chan's so hardworking～

name: 小糸
text: と、当然だよ……！
trans: T-That's to be expected...!

name: 円香
text: じゃ、テスト撮影はこのくらいで────
trans: Okay, that should be enough for the test────

name: 雛菜
text:
じゃあ雛菜、バッグの中身紹介やる～！
えっとね～……──
trans:
Alright then, Hinana will show everyone what's in her
bag～! Let's see～...──

name: 小糸
text: ひ、雛菜ちゃん、課題はいいの……？
trans: H-Hinana-chan, aren't you doing your homework...?

name: 雛菜
text: へ～
trans: Heh～

name: 雛菜
text:
最近使ってるコスメポーチはこれ～
かわいいでしょ～
trans:
This is the cosmetic pouch I've been using lately～
Isn't it super cute～?

name: 小糸
text:
う、うん
可愛いね
trans: Y-Yea, it sure is.

name: 円香
text: それから？
trans: And so?

name: 雛菜
text:
イヤホンに財布でしょ～、パスケース、お菓子……と──
ユアクマちゃん～！
trans:
Of course there's my earphones and wallet～ ID case,
snacks and......── YourKuma-chan～!

name: 小糸
text: あれ、課題は……？
trans: Hm, what about your homework......?

name: 雛菜
text:
持ってきてない～
だって重いし、雛菜ほとんど終わってるから～
trans:
Didn't bring ehem～　Cos they're so heavy, and
Hinana's nearly finished too～

name: 円香
text: ……小糸、諦めな
trans: ......Don't give up, Koito.

name: 透
text: えっと……P46の問いを読んで……
trans: Erm... So, for question on page 46...

name: 小糸
text: もー……！
trans: Geez, you guys......!

name: 円香
text:
それで──どうする？
Vlogのカメラ、持ち回りで担当する？
trans:
And so── How are we gonna do it? Should we pass
around the camera to get vlog footage?

name: 透
text:
あー
いいんじゃない？　それで
trans:
Ahhー
Why not? Let's do that.

name: 雛菜
text: 毎回集まるの、大変だもんね～
trans:
It would be troublesome to keep gathering
everytime, right～?

name: 小糸
text:
うん、ゆるい雰囲気で大丈夫みたいだし……
そしたら、誰からにする？
trans:
Yea, and the vlogs just need to have a laid-back
feel..... So, who should go first?

name: 透
text:
んー……
するか、いつもの──
trans:
Hmー...
Let's decide, with the usual──

name: 透
text:
最初はグー……
じゃーんけーん────
trans:
Rockー......
Scissors, paper────

name: 透
text: あ
trans: Ah.

name: 雛菜
text:
あは～
円香先輩が勝つの、珍しい～
trans: Aha～　It's rare for Madoka-senpai to win at these～

name: 円香
text: うるさ
trans: Quiet, you.

name: 円香
text:
どこでもいいけど
じゃ、最後で
trans:
I'm fine with any order, so...
I'll go last, then.

name: 小糸
text:
えっと……じゃあ
わたしは、２番目にしようかな……！
trans:
Erm... Then,
maybe I can go second...!

name: 雛菜
text: 透先輩は～？
trans: What about Toru-senpai～?

name: 透
text:
え、んー……
いいよ、先に決めて
trans:
Eh, hmー...
It's okay, you can pick first.

name: 雛菜
text:
いいの～？
じゃあ雛菜、３番目にする～
trans:
I can～?
Then Hinana will go third～

name: 小糸
text: そしたら、最初は透ちゃんからだね
trans: Alright then, that means Toru-chan will go first.

name: 円香
text:
はい、カメラ
ここ押せばいいだけだから
trans:
Here, the camera.
You just need to press here to shoot.

name: 透
text:
んー
オッケー
trans:
Nmー
Okayー

name: 円香
text: じゃ、よろしく
trans: I'll leave you to it, then.
